source_caption_text:
Anthony Edwards and adidas had a response ready for Drake and Kevin Durant’s sneaker commercial 😭😂

The back-and-forth started when Drake appeared alongside KD in a Nike ad, playing his overenthusiastic “yes man” while hyping up Durant’s purple KD19s. During the skit, Drake joked that only “four kids in Minnesota” were asking for Ant’s purple sneakers. 

Edwards’ camp flipped that joke into a campaign features his brother Bubba and longtime friend Nick Maddox delivering purple adidas AE3s to cheering fans in Minnesota the exact audience Drake had joked about. A crate marked “Fragile” and “Return to Toronto” adds another direct reference to Drake’s appearance in the original commercial.
